content: Time-series/velocity data modeling: dominant pattern is append-only event tables where each row is an immutable timestamped snapshot (never updated), letting history accumulate simply by inserting new rows. Static/slow-changing attributes (name, source, category) belong in a separate dimension/entity table keyed by a stable ID, not duplicated per snapshot. Velocity/derived metrics are computed by querying consecutive snapshots for the same entity ID, not stored redundantly in the entity table. Confirmed across Google Bigtable, AWS Timestream, and general time-series DB docs.
